note: Filled in from docs/accessibility-assessment.md after each round of testing.

done.result: axe-core 4.11 ran on every page, at phone and desktop widths, in light and dark schemes, and with each calculator showing a result and an error. It found no violations. Where it could not judge the contrast of some text, a script measured each case, and none was below the required ratio.
done.environment: Chrome 154 on macOS (Apple silicon), driven by script.

done.result: At 320 CSS pixels wide, no page scrolls sideways. Wide tables and charts scroll inside their own area.
done.environment: Chrome 154 on macOS (Apple silicon), driven by script.

done.result: With the spacing of WCAG 1.4.12 applied, no text was cut off on any page.
done.environment: Chrome 154 on macOS (Apple silicon), driven by script.

done.result: No control is smaller than 24 by 24 CSS pixels, apart from links inside a sentence, which the guidelines exempt. Some controls are between 24 and 43 pixels high, below our own aim of 44.
done.environment: Chrome 154 on macOS (Apple silicon), driven by script.

done.result: A script pressed Tab through every page. Every control was reached, in reading order, with an outline style set when focused, and none was covered by other content. A person has not looked at the outline on every control.
done.environment: Chrome 154 on macOS (Apple silicon), driven by script.

done.result: No page skips a heading level.
done.environment: Chrome 154 on macOS (Apple silicon), driven by script.

done.result: Every explanation can be read. Each calculator shows a notice and a worked example or default result.
done.environment: Chrome 154 on macOS (Apple silicon), driven by script.

not_done.reason: Not yet tested by a person. This needs someone to listen to each page and each calculator.
Not yet tested. No Windows computer was available.
The keyboard check was made by a script. A person has not yet worked through each calculator with a keyboard alone.

not_done.check: Zoom to 200% and 400% in a browser
not_done.reason: Reflow was measured at the equivalent width by script. A person has not yet zoomed each page in a browser.
Tested at phone width on a computer only, not on a phone.

not_done.check: Use by disabled and older readers
not_done.reason: We have held no usability sessions.

not_done.reason: Some choices change other fields at once: the household, the scenario, the number of years, the first year and the pension series. A person has not yet judged whether each change is clear.
